definition: A plan diagram drawn for this very style: the style is one the diagram itself names as its own. The composer counts that in the diagram's favour, and it is among the style's plan types.
basis: Our wording of the composer's nativity relation. build/compose.py, nativity: "Native means the style itself is one the diagram was drawn for: the style's id is in the parti's own list of styles." and "One spelling of that relation (WP-14.19, ruled 25 Sep 2026), read by `pick_partis` below and by `core.list_partis`"; mcp_server/core.py, list_partis: "Native and lineage partis are listed; a borrowed one only with `include_borrowed`, because a style's plan types are the diagrams its own line was drawn with."
